conviction_note: A mild negative lean (p_up 46 on a 4.0% scale). The company said in writing that last year's record Q2 came from the record 2025 heat, and summer 2026 was much less hot, so Q2 (Jun-Aug) growth should slow from Q1's +12% against a tough comparison. That is partly offset by a habitually conservative plan, and the likely release of a forecast that folds in the Sanki merger adds size but no clear direction. The two measurements agree in sign: impact_sum -1.0 against scaled -0.32. The scaled number is smaller because the weather series is public (LESSONS rule 1) and this name has sold beats.
bar: No H1 company plan (通期 only: OP 2,001 / 経常 2,010 / NP 1,323, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6086). IFIS consensus FY 経常 2,050 and Q1 consensus 470 against an actual 497 (https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=6086). The H1 bar is therefore inferred: last year's H1 経常 of 1,195 grown at the Q1 rate gives about 1,290, and my estimate is about 1,240, so -3%. The bar is partly unsourced, so the sizes are capped small.

findings.finding: The company's own FY26 H1 supplementary deck credits the record Q2 (Jun-Aug 2025, 経常 +23.6%, OP margin 8.2%) to 猛暑 lifting aircon requests, and puts aircon at 30% of sales. Summer 2026 was much less hot than the record 2025 summer (anomaly +1.02C against +2.36C; 猛暑日 7,529 station-days against 9,385). That points to a slower Q2 against a heat-inflated comparison, and possibly a flat or lower 6-8月期 経常 headline. It is partly offset by more 40C days (36 against 30) and 17 typhoons, both of which the company names as failure drivers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last year's Q2 print (2025-10-10, 15:30) had 経常 +25.8% at 70% progress and no revision, and fell 2.61% the next session (Yahoo closes 1,149 to 1,119). Q1 FY27 (経常 +5.3%) rose 5.1%, but that print came with the merger announcement.
findings.why_not_priced: The weather series is public, but nobody covers this ¥22bn Growth name in a way that turns it into a Q2 number: there is no IFIS H1 or Q2 estimate, and kabuyoho shows only a FY 2,050 consensus, 2% above plan. If the market had priced a weak Q2, the FY consensus would sit at or below the plan rather than above it, and the stock would not have bounced 5% off the 10-05 low into the print.
findings.independence: The weather data comes from a different source: https://weather-jwa.jp/?p=16259 (2026 summer +1.02C, 5th; 2025 +2.36C, 1st; 猛暑日 7,529 against 9,385). The company link comes from the same deck's own Q&A ('夏場の猛暑や台風の影響で機器故障が多く発生する') and from the FY26 Q2 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251010/140120250912557335.pdf, '昨夏をも上回る猛暑日が続いた影響で空調設備のメンテナンス需要がさらに上積み').

findings.finding: The Sanki Service share exchange was signed 2026-07-15 with outside advisers JBMA and Maxus plus legal counsel, and approved at a 2026-09-04 EGM. It will be accounted for as an acquisition, so deal costs are expensed as incurred and probably sit in Q2 (Jun-Aug) SG&A on top of the weather headwind.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior M&A cost line at this company. The baseline shows a median estimated reaction of 4.42%.
findings.why_not_priced: The amount is not disclosed anywhere, and no Q2 estimate exists to have absorbed it. It is small next to quarterly OP of about 700m, which is why it is sized as a fraction.
findings.independence: The EGM result notice (https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20260904/140120260902530908/) confirms the process ran through the period. No independent number exists.

findings.finding: The merger notice says the deal's effect on results 'cannot be estimated at present' and that a forecast revision will be disclosed when needed. Sanki is consolidated from 2026-12-01, so a revised FY forecast including Dec-Feb may land with this print. Sanki's Dec-Feb quarter is structurally weak (OP 121m on 6,002m sales in FY26; -20m the year before), and goodwill arises because the consideration (about ¥12bn at 1.92 x Sanki shares) is far above Sanki's ¥5.6bn net assets. A revision would therefore add revenue but little or negative profit after amortisation and costs.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The company has never revised at Q2: FY24 revised 24/02/14, FY25 25/01/14, FY26 26/01/14 (dividend only), per the kabutan 修正履歴. Its FY guide print (2026-04-14, +6% 経常) fell 4.42%.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether a consolidated forecast comes now or after 12-01 is unknown, and so is the goodwill. The IFIS FY consensus (2,050) is clearly standalone. The sign is genuinely ambiguous, so this mainly raises abs_move rather than carrying direction.
findings.independence: Sanki's quarterly profile: https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6044 (Dec-Feb OP 121m and -20m; FY27 forecast left '－'). EGM materials: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260814/140120260812518211.pdf.

findings.finding: The plan looks conservative against the company's own record. FY26 経常 came in at 1,897 against a 1,700 plan (+11.6%), Q1 FY27 経常 of 497 beat the IFIS Q1 consensus of 470 at 24.7% progress against a 5-year average of 22.4%, and the FY27 plan assumes only +6% 経常 against Q1's +12% revenue growth. So even a flat Q2 leaves H1 progress around 61-62%, above the 5-year H1 average of 56%. That gives the headline a 'progress above average' read.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The same setup last year (70% progress, plan held) fell 2.61%. This name has sold its strong H1.
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced: Q1 has been public since July. It stays as the strongest positive the release can carry, filed under LESSONS rule 2.
findings.independence: https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=6086 (IFIS Q1 consensus 470, FY 2,050). https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6086&b=k202510100023 (last year's H1 at 70.0% against a 56.0% 5-year average).

outside_window.finding: The Sanki share exchange takes effect 2026-12-01: the name changes to 三機シンメンテHD, Sanki delists 11-27 and consolidation starts. A combined dividend policy is also undecided; Sanki paid ¥30, equal to about ¥15.6 per Shin Maint share, against Shin Maint's ¥22.

baseline_tension: The lean is consistent with the near-zero priced lean and cuts slightly against the +3.7% five-day bounce. The strongest positive the release could carry is a conservative plan that leaves H1 progress above the 5-year average, and I looked for it and filed it. A buyback is contractually barred and a dividend change is historically a Q3 event.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on public series): the weather series and last year's deck are public, so p_up moved from 44 to 46. Finding sizes left unchanged, per the core's one-number rule.
Rule 2 (check the strongest positive): added the conservative-plan / above-average-progress finding at +0.3, which I had considered and not filed in the draft. impact_sum moved from -1.3 to -1.0.
